claim: In the same model at volume fraction 0.010, dipolar coupling between 6 and 9 with the active force below the gas threshold gives an active string fluid of chains and rings: more than half the particles polymerised and no cluster holding 70% of them.

validity_conditions: A MODEL RESULT. Three-dimensional overdamped active Brownian spheres with a WCA core and a point magnetic dipole along the propulsion direction, no hydrodynamics; lambda = mu^2/(kT sigma^3), f_a = Fa sigma/kT, gamma_t* = 3 so that the Peclet number va = f_a/3; HOOMD-blue on GPU (version not stated), time step 2e-4 tau with tau = 1/Dr, 8,788 particles, dipole sum without Ewald (see dipolar_active_brownian_spheres_dipole_sum_without_ewald_at_low_density); steady state reached from equilibrated passive systems by raising the active force gradually; states by cluster analysis with a 1.2 sigma neighbour cutoff: gas below half the particles polymerised, string fluid above half with the largest cluster under 70%, percolated network at 70% or more. Three-dimensional volume fraction pi rho*/6: 0.010 at rho* = 0.02 and 0.08 at rho* = 0.15. Reduced density rho* = 0.02. The active-force bound on this state is a lambda-dependent line shown only in Fig. 3.
